description: It took 30 years for Christa Pike's sentence to be set in motion. Thirty years of agony for the family of the teenage student she'd killed in a crime still embedded in public consciousness.
title: I was an official witness at Christa Pike's botched execution. Her tears, laughter, disturbing snores and the rock they placed on her chest will haunt me for ever
